title: CHIINV: 15 of 40 on a fresh never-raced gate, and 16 of 60 on the fitted corpus
status_plain: CHIINV now inverts Excel's PUBLISHED right-tail surface Q directly instead of inverting P at 1-p, because the 1-p staging carries a systematic -5 to -33 ULP bias from the rounding loss in forming 1-p. Two co-current figures exist on two corpora: 16 of 60 on the fitted b14 corpus, and 15 of 40 on b19, described in the source as fresh rows, never raced, under a heading that says held-out. The 6/40 beside it is the losing arm of the same A/B staging comparison, not CHIINV's score.
